info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Create Realestate Listings Schedule Tour-v5-spec
info.description: The Schedule Real Estate Tour API enables users to create and manage tour schedules for real estate listings. This API allows clients to coordinate property viewings seamlessly, enhancing the home-buying experience. Typical consumers include real estate agents and property management companies looking to streamline their scheduling processes. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently manage tour requests and improve customer engagement, leading to increased satisfaction and potential sales.

post.summary: Schedule a tour for a listing.
post.description: Allows users to schedule a tour for a specific listing. This operation facilitates the booking process, ensuring that potential buyers or renters can visit the property at their convenience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to schedule a tour for a listing. It must contain all necessary details about the tour, including the listing ID and preferred schedule. Ensure to provide valid data to avoid any errors during processing.

200.description: The tour request was successfully scheduled.
